sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding pump housing ph-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We highly value our long-standing partnership and appreciate your willingness to commit to a 24-month contract with 30-day payment terms. This extended planning security allows us to optimize our production, and we are pleased to offer a revised price of €51.30 per unit in return. 

Our current offer is a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Our team will address your request regarding the cost breakdown separately. Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us. It is always a pleasure working together with your respected firm, and we look forward to continuing our tradition of shared success.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
